limitations: Only two nominal final-configuration trials; not a reliability estimate
Unfavorable orientation ended FAULT with vehicle still armed in SITL; no forced disarm used
Command rejection, safety denial and communication loss are ROS contract tests, not Gazebo fault injections
Development attempts using velocity resets were invalidated and excluded; the first orientation harness deadline was too short and its rerun is reported
Mass, deployed motor geometry, propulsion, battery and sensor poses remain provisional
